verdict.rationale: Supabase docs mention that 'single sign-on (SSO)' is one of the supported auth methods, implying enterprise SSO capability, but there is no evidence of SAML/OIDC specifics, admin enforcement policies, or MFA support/enforcement for application end-users. missing for 10: explicit SAML/OIDC configuration docs, MFA (TOTP/WebAuthn) support and enforcement, admin policy to require MFA/SSO per project.
